program_description: every 100 ms a coordinator gives 8 calc threads (one per CPU) 10 ms of CPU work each and waits for all of them
fault_summary: every calc thread gets the same 10 ms of work, but a monitor thread (SCHED_FIFO 10) on calc-5's CPU spins 20 ms at the start of every round, so calc-5 is runnable but waiting and finishes last; everyone waits for it at the barrier
command: /home/snehpatel/research/TraceCompass AI Agent/symptom_bench/crunch --fault barrier_straggler -d 30s -o /home/snehpatel/research/TraceCompass AI Agent/symptom_bench/runs/crunch-4b6e/ground_truth --data /home/snehpatel/research/TraceCompass AI Agent/symptom_bench/runs/crunch-4b6e/data

threads.name: watchdog
threads.role: ends the run if the program does not end itself
